name: ui roundtrip
notes: Manual test for the web form. Paste into 'Raw spec JSON' and press 'Use this JSON'. It mixes fields the form shows (the Quality fieldset included) with fields it does not (overlays, post, secondary, season, artists), and sets the max preset with explicit opt-outs, so what the form writes back and what it keeps can both be checked.
